generationHistory.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished full horizontal Catanova logo, transparent raster asset for the game's title screen.
Input image: the attached bright Catanova mark is the exact existing identity and painterly style reference.
Primary request: create a complete logo lockup with that mark on the LEFT and the exact word "Catanova" on the RIGHT in matching bespoke friendly fantasy lettering.
Text (verbatim): "Catanova". Spell C-a-t-a-n-o-v-a. Exactly eight letters, capital C followed by lowercase atanova, no other text.
Lettering: large, very readable, lively confident letterforms with gently flared terminals and soft organic curves; each letter individually hand-painted, warm sunlit ivory-gold faces and a restrained clear teal-green painted edge/shadow for separation. Lettering feels like a thoughtful fantasy game title, joyful, graceful and sturdy rather than spiky, gothic, corporate or inflated plastic. Moderate painterly texture, subtly varied strokes, consistent baseline, calm spacing. The C in Catanova must be a real letter, do not substitute the mark for the C.
Mark: retain the open honey-gold hexagonal C, fresh meadow/jade hills, coral-red settlement roof and four-point nova spark from the reference. The entire mark should be about 1.4 times the lettering height, not enormous. Keep a clear modest gap between the mark and first letter.
Composition: one complete horizontal logo, approximately 3:1 landscape, centered and filling the canvas closely with even small transparent margins. One continuous word, all letters clearly visible. Keep it compact enough for a landing page header.
Background: REAL transparent alpha. Empty transparent background behind logo and between all letters; no colored rectangle, no white background, no checkerboard or paper.
Constraints: only mark and the word Catanova. No subtitle, tagline, plaque, wooden sign, ribbon, box, outer border, duplicated mark, extra decorative objects, resource icons or extra stars. No existing game branding. No huge outline, chrome, glossy extrusion, or fake 3D bevel. The lettering and mark should look painted by the same artist.
